BEGIN;

-- Never discard private pending delivery state during rollback.
LOCK TABLE teacher_dialog_job IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE status = 'blocked' AND response_body IS NOT NULL) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '025 rollback refused: retained pending Practice response requires verified delivery';
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check;

ALTER TABLE teacher_dialog_job
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_shape_check
        CHECK (
            (status = 'queued' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'processing' AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL
                AND ((decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL)
                    OR (decision_id IS NOT NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (coordinator_mode <> 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NULL AND response_body IS NOT NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'delivery_pending' AND response_body IS NOT NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND reconciliation_state IS NULL
                AND ((coordinator_mode = 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (coordinator_mode <> 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'delivered' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND (teacher_turn_schema_version = 1 OR teacher_response_message_id IS NOT NULL) AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL AND (terminal_outcome IS NULL OR terminal_outcome = 'delivered') AND reconciliation_state IS NULL
                AND ((coordinator_mode = 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (coordinator_mode <> 'legacy' AND decision_id IS NULL)))
            OR
            (status = 'completed' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_message_id IS NULL AND teacher_response_message_id IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND terminal_outcome = 'failed_no_effect' AND reconciliation_state IS NULL AND no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL AND recoverable_outcome_id IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'blocked' AND response_body IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL
                AND ((delivered_message_id IS NULL AND teacher_response_message_id IS NULL)
                    OR (reconciliation_state = 'committed_unreconciled' AND delivered_message_id IS NOT NULL AND teacher_response_message_id = delivered_message_id)))
        );

COMMIT;
